Aarav identified that BCE years count down toward 1 BCE and CE years increase.

end.parentNote: Asha used a drawn number line to practise placing BCE dates on the left and CE dates on the right. Aarav successfully gave one full date order and explained that BCE numbers decrease toward 1 BCE, but they mixed up the direction again later, so this was not fully corrected by the end. At home, draw a short timeline with 3000 BCE, 500 BCE, 1 BCE, 100 CE, and 1947 CE, then ask Aarav to place them and explain the rule aloud.
